next_action.description: ASK FABIO TWO THINGS BEFORE DOING ANYTHING: (1) did his LoRA-hunting agent find 9B style LoRAs, and has he already changed the workflow to add them? key_decisions: ONE template, TWO runtime files. 4B and 9B are the same graph; generate_klein.py swaps four weight names plus Input_is_9b. A hand-maintained 9B twin template was explicitly REJECTED by Fabio - once 9B gains styles the gate disappears too, leaving nothing but the filenames, so two templates would be two copies of one graph drifting apart.
LanPaint is pinned UPSTREAM, not forked and not vendored. Fabio's call: a fork earns its keep only when we change the code. Vendoring GPL-3.0 into a first-party repo would relicence it permanently.

9B ships STYLELESS for now - no 9B-trained style LoRAs exist. The rack NODES stay in the graph and Input_is_9b routes around them, so adding styles later is a value change plus dep entries, not a rebuild.

The outpaint LoRA left both Klein GRAPHS (LanPaint replaced that path) but its dep entry, R2 object and models.js:973 listing all deliberately REMAIN. MPI-603 owns that retirement and it is BLOCKED on the Character Sheet flow.
Local-app testing before any Pod spend was Fabio's ordering and it was right: it proved the wiring AND produced the display asset in one step.
constraints: STYLE LoRAs ARE A LIVE MOVING PART. Fabio has an agent searching for 9B equivalents of the 4B style set, and said he will change the workflow himself if it finds them. ASK HIM before assuming the styleless posture still holds - do not read the current ModelDef or template as settled.

His call.

EVERY smoke-workflows.mjs INVOCATION REWRITES dev_configs/smoke-run.txt, --plan INCLUDED. This session's --plan truncated a 183-line recovered transcript; it was restored with `git show HEAD:<path> > <path>`. The file's own header warns about exactly this. Back it up before any invocation.

A GPU LEASE HOOK guards smoke-workflows.mjs. It matches the script PATH anywhere in a Bash command unless --plan or --self-check also appears, so even a grep mentioning the file is blocked. Use the Grep tool for reading it, and gpu_lease.py run -- for anything real.

models.js IS CO-OWNED RIGHT NOW - a peer has three uncommitted SDXL enhanceRecipe hunks in it (MPI-25). This session staged only its own hunks via a filtered `git apply --cached` then a bare `git commit -n`. Do NOT use `git commit --only` on that file; it commits the WORKING TREE version and sweeps the peer's work in.
SIDECAR MODEL FIELD IS `modelId`, NOT `model`. A direct d.get('model') reads None and makes a proven generation look unproven.

The app engine maps base_path G:/CubricModels via extra_model_paths.yaml, so weights on that drive need no download. The BENCH (port 8188) and the APP engine (48188) are separate installs - LanPaint being on one says nothing about the other.
